title: Underlying sectionwise proper/open counit is monic
statement: With the hypotheses of the proper/open counit, applying the forgetful functor from ringed-site modules to presheaves of modules to the counit component yields a monomorphism.

source.place: Injectivity half of the affine proper/open support argument (Tags 09AE and 09AG)

proof.text: Evaluate the zero-extension presheaf map on an affine pro-etale object. It is the identity on sections factoring through the open and the zero map on the complementary summands, hence injective. Exact sheafification preserves this injectivity, and proper base change identifies the sheafified map with the underlying counit map.
